lines.text: Abraham makes his chief servant swear to find a wife for Isaac from his own country and kindred.
Abraham says the LORD will send His angel ahead, and the servant swears the oath.
The servant takes twelve camels to Nahor's hometown and makes them kneel near the well at evening.
Rebekah, daughter of Bethuel, gives the servant a drink and draws water for all his camels.
The servant bows down and worships the LORD, the God of his master Abraham, at the spring in Haran.
